design_consequences: Use three explorer lanes: governed meaning and authority; live-presentation pedagogy plus agent memory/context; and comparative repository examples culminating in Augmentor.

Require a single retellable chain: sources and events become selected evidence; ontology types their meaning and relations; authority gates decide what may be relied upon; an agent receives a bounded context view with warnings.
Introduce formal vocabulary only after a concrete failure is visible, and keep one visible thought per presentation moment.
Treat time and confidence as part of meaning and safe-use conditions, not decorative node metadata.
